title: Add Pollinations for Figma to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations for Figma](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-figma) to image
- A Figma plugin that generates and edits images with Pollinations inside the canvas, on the user's own Pollen. **What it does** - **Generate onto the canvas.** The prompt goes to GET /image/{prompt} an

Fixes #15713, fixes #15572

gist.headline: Pixels meet the canvas
gist.blurb: Pollinations for Figma brings image generation and editing into the design canvas. No tab-hopping required; bring your own Pollen.
gist.summary: Added the community-built Pollinations for Figma plugin to the app directory, letting designers generate and edit images inside Figma using their own Pollen, with generation sent to GET /image/{prompt}.
gist.impact: Designers can place generated images directly on the Figma canvas and edit images there using their own Pollen.
gist.visual_concept: Show a cozy Figma-style design canvas with an image appearing in a frame, flower-shaped controls, and Polli helping position it. A tiny painter's beret connects Polli to the design task.
gist.image_prompt: On a cozy pixel art design canvas, Polli in a tiny painter's beret helps place a newly generated flower-garden image into a frame. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow, warm cream canvas, and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
